title: Cosmic Oracle with Crystal Ball
description: A multi-faced female figure with long flowing green hair holds a large crystal ball in her left hand. Inside the glowing orb, a lone astronaut walks across a purple alien landscape beneath a red ringed planet, while the surrounding dark cosmic scene features mountains, stars, floating geometric shapes, white ghostly figures, and a tall stack of worm-like creatures on the right.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a multi-faced female oracle with long flowing green hair and dark patterned robes, holding a glowing crystal ball that contains an astronaut walking on a purple lavender field under a red ringed planet. The dark starry background shows mountains, a large red planet with rings, a purple pyramid, floating triangles, a tall stack of worm-like creatures, and glowing white ghostly human figures walking through the field, intricate ink line art with vibrant colors.
